title: Wire up the orphaned sound or delete it
ask: A sound file ships that systems/audio_manager.gd never loads. From outside, a forgotten cut and a wiring bug look identical — work out which this is, then either wire it up or delete it and say why in the commit.
first_action: Compare assets/audio/sfx against the preloads in systems/audio_manager.gd, then listen to the orphan and decide.
